newsitem.title: UK: Freight market softer, outlook uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Freight market softer, outlook uncertain.

text.p: The freight market was marginally softer in some areas - panamaxes in the far east, for example - but in general fairly steady ahead of the easter holidays.
Many brokers were reluctant to express views on the prospects for April which were said to be difficult to evaluate.
The BFI was down 5 points to 1513.
Handysize rates were stable in most trades but said to be firming for modern vessels on the Continent the Baltic Handy Index was up 2 to 1109.
GRAIN - Dreyfus finally fixed their caper requirement Mississippi/Rotterdam with Commander 123,180 dwt (4,595,000 cft) for 1/5 April for a lumpsum of $1,050,000.

S.Korean charterers were understood to have fixed panamax tonnage for April US Gulf/Japan stems, but reports that Pan Ocean booked Tai Chang for 52/54,000 heavy grain for 5/18 April at $25.75 no combo were believed to be erroneous.
Reports here suggested this 1982-built vessel of 64,730 dwt was covered instead by Hanjin on timecharter delivery US Gulf mid April trip Far East at close to $13,750 daily plus about $275,000 bonus.

The 1996-built Cobelfret-relet Atlantic Princess 73,565 dwt was also reported fixed in this trade (by Pan Pcean) at $15,250 daily plus $285,000 bonus, having failed on cancelling date with Andre tonnage to be nominated at $25.75 no combo.

Market rumours suggested Toepfer had booked a panamax for Plate/Aqaba but details were lacking, and that Tradigrain paid a firm $13,000 daily for the 1979-built Athena 61,500 dwt delivery prompt Gibraltar for a trip via the Plate to Trincomalee.

Glencore were linked with the 1977-built Kosmaj 72,050 dwt delivery spot Annaba for a S.American round voyage at $10,600 daily. The Klaveness-relet Anthi P 63,987 dwt was reported fixed delivery prompt Passero on private terms.

In the east Halla fixed the newbuilding Oinoussian Legend 71,170 dwt delivery spot ex yard Japan for a Nopac round with grain at an easier $13,000 daily. The Australian wheat board covered 50,000 wheat S.Australia/Pt Qaboos for first half April at just over $16.00.

MINERALS - Not a great deal of information surfaced in an uneasy market for owners just before the Easter holidays. Vakis T was booked by Yukong for about 110,000 coal la Cienaga/Rotterdam for mid April at $5.90 (in place of the older Orfeas which failed on subjects at $5.40).

New Harvest was said to be on subjects with Eastern Rich for 200,000 ironore W.Australia/Beilun for end April at $5.25. Pisces Planter 41,797 dwt will ballast from honkong to deliver Richards Bay 10/20 April to perform a coal voyage to Japan for account of Kambara Kisen at $9,500 daily plus $140,000 bonus.
